bills.title: Protect Female Sports Act
pull_quotes: An interscholastic or intramural athletic team or sport sponsored by a school or athletic association that is designated for females, women, or girls must not be open for participation by a male student or male participant.

bills.description: Concerning safeguarding a minor from health-care interventions intended to alter the minor's biological sex.
bills.title: Safeguard Minors from Sex-Altering Interventions
pull_quotes: A person, health-care provider, or mental health professional shall not knowingly: (a) perform surgery on a minor who is under eighteen years old, or prescribe, administer, or provide hormones or puberty blockers to a minor, for the purpose of altering the minor's biological sex characteristics; or (b) provide mental health therapy, professional counseling, or referrals that promote or affirm a minor's belief that the minor was born in the wrong body or that the minor needs medical intervention to address distress related to the minor's biological sex.

bills.description: Concerning the statute of limitations for youth gender transition procedures.
bills.title: Limitation on Gender Transition Procedure Claims
pull_quotes: The bill requires that a cause of action for an intentional or negligent act for an injury as a result of a youth gender transition procedure by a provider must be brought before the youth reaches 38 years old.
